name: search_tank_items
description: Search collected source items by text over at most the preceding 90 days, returning at most 20 matching source documents and excerpts. This queries stored observations without external network requests. Read the full item before citing an excerpt or deciding that two items describe the same event.

source_ids.description: Registered source keys (reg.sources), shown after « · » next to the name in Tank's messages and results, e.g. S29 or S32.

name: web_search
description: Search public web text using pinned ddgs with DuckDuckGo only. Requests are spaced by at least 2 seconds; rate-limit, block and timeout failures retry after 5,15,45 seconds, then return an explicit error without another search engine. Returns up to 10 titles, URLs and snippets stored as evidence. Search snippets are discovery data; fetch the source page before using a factual quote.

name: record_review
description: Record the adversarial review of the current proposal: verdict, reason, the four 0–10 scores and the recommendation. Cite stored claims, events or source documents by ID as evidence, and name an earlier open proposal of the same concept in duplicate_of by its proposal ID. The host binds the current proposal.

evidence.description: Each entry cites one stored record by its ID: {claim_id} for a claim, {event_id} for an event or {item_id} for a source document; find them with read-only SQL (your skill, «Finding record IDs»).

duplicate_of.description: Proposal ID (PRP-…) of the earlier open proposal of the same concept, or null; find it with read-only SQL (your skill, «Finding record IDs»), «Proposals by subject».
